effect: The liver released glucose from its store into the blood, completing the between-meal goal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the stored chains become separate glucose again.

mostWorthwhile.text: Using insulin with muscle was worthwhile because it showed that insulin is a message, while glucose becomes the stored material.

leastWorthwhile.text: Releasing the two pancreatic messages felt a little repetitive, though the similar actions helped compare their roles.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the liver could break its stored carbohydrate back into glucose and release it into blood between meals.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained why the messages and stores belonged together.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the contrast between storing fuel and releasing it made me curious about how the body handles other changing needs.
